root_text:
A two-month-old baby from #Rajasthan tested positive for #HumanMetapneumovirus in an #Ahmedabad hospital. 

Initially on ventilator support, the child has now stabilized. #HMPV, a respiratory virus, is noted to be worldwide, including India
